decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize walls such as Overgrown Battlement, Axebane Guardian, and Tinder Wall to generate large amounts of mana, while also utilizing cards like Freed from the Real and Galvanic Alchemist to create an infinite mana combo. This combo can then be used to play powerful spells like Reaping the Graves or overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures. The deck also includes cards like Lead the Stampede and Winding Way to help find key pieces of the combo quickly.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on ramping up quickly with mana dorks like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl, while also disrupting the opponent's lands with Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst. By efficiently mana ramping and utilizing snow-covered lands, the deck aims to play powerful threats such as Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter ahead of schedule. Boarding Party and Jewel Thief provide additional aggression and card advantage, creating a fast-paced and relentless aggressive strategy that aims to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Spellstutter Sprite, the deck aims to maintain tempo and control the board. Cards like Mutagenic Growth and Snap provide additional flexibility and ways to protect key creatures. The synergy between Faerie Seer, Faerie Miscreant, and Of One Mind helps to keep the hand full and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, this mono blue aggro deck focuses on efficient creatures and countermagic to secure a fast victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly flood the board with artifact creatures, supported by a variety of artifacts and spells that provide card advantage and removal. By utilizing the Affinity mechanic to reduce the cost of artifact spells, this Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of efficient threats while also having access to burn spells for direct damage. Additionally, the deck includes recursion and sacrifice outlets to further support its aggressive game plan.

The main strategy of this UR Control deck is to control the board by countering opponent spells with Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also utilizing removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to maintain card advantage through card draw with cards like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Preordain. Augur of Bolas helps find relevant cards, while Faerie Seer and Spellstutter Sprite provide early board presence. The deck also includes some creatures like Crimson Fleet Commodore and Moon-Circuit Hacker for additional threats. Overall, the deck focuses on control and tempo to outmaneuver opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manage the opponent's threats and disrupt their game plan. It includes a mix of counterspells, card draw, and removal spells to outlast opponents. Additionally, it aims to take advantage of graveyard synergies with cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Gurmag Angler. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing flexibility with lands like Contaminated Aquifer and Ice Tunnel. Overall, the deck seeks to control the game and outvalue opponents through efficient card advantage and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to use card draw and removal spells to maintain control of the game while building up mana and resources. By using cards like Mental Note, Preordain, and Thought Scour to draw cards and filter through the deck, along with spells like Snuff Out and Counterspell to deal with threats, the deck aims to survive until it can cast powerful finishers like Gurmag Angler. Unexpected Fangs provides a surprise element and Tolarian Terror and Contaminated Aquifer help fix mana while Ice Tunnel provides additional versatility.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost creatures and a mix of countermagic and disruptive spells. By using efficient creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Brinebarrow Intruder, along with spells like Counterspell and Spellstutter Sprite, the deck aims to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes card draw and bounce effects to keep the pressure on and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Reaping the Graves and Songs of the Damned to generate a substantial amount of mana and resources, allowing for explosive plays and powerful activations. The deck also includes cycling creatures like Horror of the Broken Lands and Drannith Stinger to cycle through the deck and find key pieces. Additionally, there are some support cards like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to further accelerate the deck's game plan. This deck focuses on quickly assembling its combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with sheer power.

The overarching idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with small, evasive creatures like Faeries and Ninjas, while using cheap instants and counterspells to protect them. By maintaining card advantage with cards like Of One Mind and Ninja of the Deep Hours, the deck can keep up the pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key is to be aggressive yet strategic, using efficient spells and creatures to consistently apply pressure and control the tempo of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures, utilizing efficient removal spells and key enchantments to control the board. By using a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful enchantments like Armadillo Cloak, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can establish a strong defense. With a mix of aggressive creatures and defensive options like Saruli Gatekeepers and Relic of Progenitus, the deck has the versatility to adapt to different matchups and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing cheap artifact creatures and cards that benefit from having artifacts in play. By playing efficient creatures like Frogmite and Myr Enforcer early on, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and finish the game with burn spells like Galvanic Blast. Additionally, synergies with sacrificing artifacts for value, such as with Makeshift Munitions and Drossforge Bridge, help maintain momentum and provide additional reach. The deck aims to outpace the opponent and win the game through a combination of creature damage and direct burn spells.

The main focus of this Red Deck Wins Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, high-damage spells and creatures. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Monastery Swiftspear, along with artifact creatures like Experimental Synthesizer and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to deal damage fast and efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Bushwhacker to generate tokens and pump up the team for increased aggression. The use of snow-covered lands and cards like Fireblast and Lava Dart allows for additional damage potential and flexibility in gameplay.

The deck focuses on using walls and creatures with defender to generate mana and search for combo pieces. By using cards like Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement to produce mana, as well as cards like Drift of Phantasms and Lead the Stampede to find combo pieces, the player aims to assemble the Freed from the Real combo with Galvanic Alchemist or Valakut Invoker to generate infinite mana and win the game. The deck also includes recursion and card draw to help find and protect the combo pieces.

The core focus of this deck is building a fast and aggressive strategy to overwhelm opponents with quick and efficient damage. By utilizing a combination of low-cost spells like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Chain Lightning, along with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Voldaren Epicure, this deck aims to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. With the ability to generate extra creatures through Kuldotha Rebirth and card advantage with Reckless Impulse, this deck is designed to put pressure on opponents early and maintain that pressure throughout the game.

The main concept of this Red Deck Wins Pauper deck is to utilize low-cost and efficient burn spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal large amounts of damage in a short amount of time. It focuses on aggressive play and using cheap removal and direct damage to control the board and push through for quick victories. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain that aggression throughout the game, utilizing creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and burn spells like Lightning Bolt to secure wins.
